tasks.label: jhin: build
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && ./gradlew build
tasks.description: Build every included build of the root composite (sdk, kernel, plugins).

tasks.label: jhin: test
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && ./gradlew :sdk:test :kernel:test :jhin-plugin-sessions:test :jhin-plugin-security:test :jhin-plugin-llm:test :jhin-plugin-llm-builtin:test :jhin-plugin-agent:test :jhin-plugin-tools-builtin:test :jhin-plugin-mcp:test :jhin-plugin-ui-kit:test :jhin-plugin-ui-default:test :jhin-plugin-reload:test :jhin-plugin-example:test
tasks.description: Run the test task of every build in the composite in one Gradle invocation (mirrors the jhin-test devenv script).

tasks.label: jhin: dist
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && ./gradlew dist
tasks.description: Assemble the distributable bundle (placeholder until the dist task lands in T44).

tasks.label: jhin: kernel jar
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && ./gradlew :kernel:bootJar
tasks.description: Build only the kernel boot jar; other jhin tasks depend on this.

tasks.label: jhin: run kernel
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && exec java -jar "$(ls kernel/build/libs/kernel-*.jar | grep -v -- '-plain\.jar$' | head -1)"
tasks.description: Run the kernel boot jar (plugins are loaded from JHIN_HOME/plugins).

tasks.label: jhin: run kernel (debug :5005)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && exec java -agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=*:5005 -jar "$(ls kernel/build/libs/kernel-*.jar | grep -v -- '-plain\.jar$' | head -1)"
tasks.description: Run the kernel boot jar with the JDWP debug agent listening on port 5005.

tasks.label: jhin: install plugin
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && test -d "plugins/${input:plugin}" && ./gradlew ":jhin-plugin-${input:plugin}:jar" && mkdir -p "${JHIN_HOME:-$HOME/.jhin}/plugins" && cp plugins/${input:plugin}/build/libs/*.jar "${JHIN_HOME:-$HOME/.jhin}/plugins/"
tasks.description: Build one plugin jar and copy it into the JHIN_HOME plugins directory.

tasks.label: jhin: link plugins
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && home_plugins="${JHIN_HOME:-$HOME/.jhin}/plugins" && mkdir -p "$home_plugins" && set -- && for dir in plugins/*/; do name=$(basename "$dir"); [ -f "$dir/build.gradle" ] || continue; if [ "$name" = "example" ] || [ "$name" = "qa-mock-llm" ]; then continue; fi; set -- "$@" ":jhin-plugin-$name:jar"; done && ./gradlew "$@" && for dir in plugins/*/; do name=$(basename "$dir"); [ -f "$dir/build.gradle" ] || continue; if [ "$name" = "example" ] || [ "$name" = "qa-mock-llm" ]; then continue; fi; jar=$(ls "$dir"/build/libs/*.jar 2>/dev/null | grep -v -- '-plain\.jar$' | head -1 || true); [ -n "$jar" ] || continue; ln -sfn "$(realpath "$jar")" "$home_plugins/$(basename "$jar")"; echo "linked $(basename "$jar")"; done && for stale in "$home_plugins"/*.jar; do [ -L "$stale" ] || continue; case "$(basename "$stale")" in jhin-plugin-example-*|jhin-plugin-qa-mock-llm-*) rm -f "$stale"; echo "unlinked $(basename "$stale")";; esac; done
tasks.description: Build every plugin jar and symlink it into the JHIN_HOME plugins directory (mirrors the jhin-link devenv script).

tasks.label: cli: create-account
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && java -jar "$(ls kernel/build/libs/kernel-*.jar | grep -v -- '-plain\.jar$' | head -1)" cli create-account "${input:account}"
tasks.description: Run the kernel CLI subcommand create-account <name> (registered by the security plugin).

tasks.label: cli: create-enrollment
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f .devenv/profile/bin/java)")")" && export JDK21_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && java -jar "$(ls kernel/build/libs/kernel-*.jar | grep -v -- '-plain\.jar$' | head -1)" cli create-enrollment "${input:account}"
tasks.description: Run the kernel CLI subcommand create-enrollment <account> (registered by the security plugin).

inputs.description: Plugin directory name under plugins/ to build and install
Account name for the security CLI subcommand
